latestVersion.changelog:
- Introduces adaptive reasoning: skill automatically assesses task complexity before responding.
- Dynamically adjusts reasoning depth; activates advanced thinking for complex, ambiguous, or high-stakes queries.
- Uses a scoring system (0–10) to decide whether to stay fast, deliberate lightly, or enable deep reasoning.
- Visual indicator (`🧠` or `🧠🔥`) added to responses when advanced reasoning is active.
- Automatically downgrades to fast mode after complex tasks if subsequent questions are simple.
- Integration requires no external tools; can be controlled explicitly with simple commands.
